# `auth.oidc.start`

Begin an OIDC login

Mints single-use state with PKCE S256 and nonce. The page links on to the provider.

- Method and path: `GET /login/oidc/{provider}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie auth oidc start`
- MCP: `auth_oidc_start`

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `next` | query | no | `string` |
| `provider` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
